text: 阅文集团发布截至2026年6月30日止6个月中期业绩，该集团取得收入人民币35.31亿元，同比增加10.68%；毛利17.92亿元，同比增加11.15%；本公司权益持有人应占盈利1.35亿元；每股盈利0.13元。
text_en: China Literature released its interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The group achieved revenue of RMB 3.531 billion, up 10.68% year-on-year; gross profit of RMB 1.792 billion, up 11.15% year-on-year; profit attributable to equity holders of the company of RMB 135 million; and earnings per share of RMB 0.13.
